# Reference

This isolated workspace tests tables, warnings, and relative image paths.

## Rendering Checks

| Item | Expected Result |
| --- | --- |
| Shared Section | Text and links resolve in the including page. |
| Directory Entry | The workspace opens without a self-referencing next-page link. |

::: warning Important Notice
Rendering checks do not verify EMQX runtime behavior.
:::
